FunnelStory | Principal Engineer, AI Systems | Remote (India) | Full-Time | funnelstory.ai

FunnelStory builds a queryable context graph over enterprise data — the infrastructure layer that lets AI agents reason over live customer intelligence. We've built a federated query engine purpose-built for agents, ML models from scratch in Go (health scoring, cohort expansion, process mining, Markov chains, Genetic Pareto optimization), and on-prem deployment infrastructure for enterprise customers. All on a deterministically tested backend.

We need engineers who go deep. The kind who read academic papers to build something novel, then hunt down a performance bottleneck five layers deep in the stack. Go is preferred but not required. Strong math and systems engineering background is a plus. What's required: ability to solve hard problems, use AI tooling to add real value (not slop), and drive work forward independently.

Please reach out to me directly at preetam @ funnelstory.ai with "HN" in the subject.
